caption:
A realistic day of food, start to finish.

The 3pm crash used to get me every day. What changed it was protein at breakfast and an actual lunch instead of a sandwich at my desk.

The 3:30 swap is the one I'd start with. A pot of Greek yoghurt has far more protein than a couple of biscuits, so it keeps you going until tea instead of setting you up for another sugar dip.

Save this for your next workday, and send it to the colleague who lives on meal deals.
